back_translation: The word that the LORD spoke concerning Babylon and the land of the Chaldeans, through Jeremiah the prophet.

Announce among the nations and proclaim; lift up a banner and proclaim; do not conceal it; say, Babylon is captured; Bel is put to shame; Marduk is shattered; her images are put to shame; her idols are broken in pieces.
For a nation from the north has come up against her; it will make her land a desolation, and no one will dwell in it; both man and beast have fled and gone.
In those days and at that time, declares the LORD, the children of Israel and the children of Judah will come together; they will go weeping as they go, and they will seek the LORD their God.
They will ask the way to Zion, with their faces toward it: Come, let us join ourselves to the LORD in an everlasting covenant that will not be forgotten.
My people have been lost sheep; their shepherds led them astray, turning them away on the mountains; they went from mountain to hill and forgot their resting place.
All who found them devoured them, and their enemies said, We are not guilty, because they have sinned against the LORD, the abode of righteousness, the LORD, the hope of their fathers.
Flee from the midst of Babylon, and go out from the land of the Chaldeans, and be like the he-goats before the flock.

For behold, I am stirring up and bringing against Babylon an assembly of great nations from the land of the north; they will line up against her; from there she will be captured. Their arrows are like a skilled warrior who does not return empty-handed.
And Chaldea will become plunder; all who plunder her will be satisfied, declares the LORD.
Because you rejoice, because you exult, O plunderers of my inheritance, because you frolic like a heifer treading grain and neigh like stallions,
your mother will be greatly ashamed; she who bore you will be disgraced. Behold, she will be the least of the nations, a wilderness, a dry land, and a desert.
Because of the wrath of the LORD she will not be inhabited, but will become wholly desolate; everyone who passes by Babylon will be appalled and will hiss at all her wounds.
Line up against Babylon all around, all you who draw the bow; shoot at her, spare no arrows, for she has sinned against the LORD.

Raise a war cry against her on every side; she has surrendered; her towers have fallen; her walls are torn down. For this is the vengeance of the LORD; take vengeance on her; as she has done, do to her.
Cut off from Babylon the sower and the one who wields the sickle at harvest time; before the oppressor's sword each will turn to his own people, and each will flee to his own land.
Israel is a scattered sheep, chased by lions; the first to devour him was the king of Assyria, and this last one crushed his bones—Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.
Therefore this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: Behold, I will punish the king of Babylon and his land, as I punished the king of Assyria.
And I will bring Israel back to his pasture, and he will graze on Carmel and Bashan, and his soul will be satisfied on the hills of Ephraim and Gilead.

In those days and at that time, declares the LORD, the iniquity of Israel will be sought, but there will be none, and the sins of Judah, but they will not be found; for I will forgive the remnant I leave.
Go up against the land of Merathaim, and against the inhabitants of Pekod; kill and devote them to destruction, declares the LORD, and do all that I have commanded you.
The noise of battle is in the land, and great destruction.
How the hammer of the whole earth is cut down and broken! How Babylon has become a horror among the nations!
I laid a snare for you, O Babylon, and you were caught, and you did not know it; you were found and seized, because you challenged the LORD.
The LORD has opened his armory and brought out the weapons of his wrath, for this is the work of the Lord GOD of Hosts in the land of the Chaldeans.
Come against her from the farthest border; open her granaries; pile her up like heaps of grain and devote her to destruction; let her have no remnant.
Kill all her young bulls; let them go down to the slaughter. Woe to them, for their day has come, the time of their punishment.
Listen—fugitives and refugees from the land of Babylon, declaring in Zion the vengeance of the LORD our God, the vengeance for his temple.

Summon archers against Babylon, all who string the bow; encamp around her, let none escape; repay her according to her deeds, do to her according to all that she has done; for she has acted arrogantly against the LORD, against the Holy One of Israel.
Therefore her young men will fall in her streets, and all her warriors will be silenced in that day, declares the LORD.
Behold, I am against you, O arrogant one, declares the Lord GOD of Hosts, for your day has come, the time when I will punish you.
The arrogant one will stumble and fall, with no one to raise him up; and I will kindle a fire in his cities, and it will devour all around him.
This is what the LORD of Hosts says: The children of Israel are oppressed, and the children of Judah together; all their captors hold them fast, refusing to release them.
Their Redeemer is strong; the LORD of Hosts is his name. He will surely plead their cause, to bring rest to the earth but turmoil to the inhabitants of Babylon.
A sword against the Chaldeans, declares the LORD, and against the inhabitants of Babylon, and against her officials and her wise men.
A sword against the diviners, and they will become fools; a sword against her warriors, and they will be terrified.
A sword against her horses and her chariots and against all the foreigners in her midst, and they will become like women; a sword against her treasuries, and they will be plundered.
A drought upon her waters, and they will be dried up; for it is a land of graven images, and they go mad over dreadful idols.
Therefore desert creatures and hyenas will dwell there, and ostriches will dwell in it; it will never again be inhabited or lived in from generation to generation.
As God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and their neighbors, declares the LORD, no one will dwell there, and no man will sojourn in it.
Behold, a people is coming from the north; a great nation and many kings are stirred up from the ends of the earth.
They grasp bow and spear; they are cruel and have no mercy; their voice roars like the sea, and they ride on horses, arrayed like a man for battle against you, O Daughter of Babylon.
The king of Babylon has heard the report of them, and his hands have grown limp; anguish has seized him, pain like a woman in labor.

Behold, one will come up like a lion from the thickets of the Jordan to the perennial pasture; for in an instant I will chase them from it, and I will appoint over it whoever is chosen; for who is like me, and who can summon me, and what shepherd can stand before me?

Therefore hear the counsel of the LORD that he has planned against Babylon, and the plans he has devised against the land of the Chaldeans: Surely the little ones of the flock will be dragged off; surely their pasture will be made desolate over them.
At the sound of Babylon's capture the earth quakes, and a cry is heard among the nations.
